integrity: Exact finite-field projective incidence enumeration with two independent C++17 checkers and distinct field models. The proof and checks are included.
scientific_limitations: Only the Hermitian quartic at q=3 over F_729 is covered.
Possible unindexed classical finite-geometry tabulations remain a priority risk.
Earlier on-curve counts are cited, not claimed as new.
title: The sharp four-secant bound for the Hermitian quartic over \(\mathbb F_{729}\)
